create_adapt_subclass: create a subclass of Adapt that implements update and run methods for a custom adaptation algorithm
build_bnadapt_instance: build a BNAdapt instance with init_params, init_state, forward function, and number of properties
run_bnadapt_update: run BNAdapt update to cache batch data and update batch norm statistics per property label
run_bnadapt_eval: run BNAdapt run method to apply interpolated batch norm states to a function per property
review_bnadapt_interpolate: review the BNAdapt _interpolate_state method that blends new and old batch norm averages with configurable weights
